[[File:Nynaeve21.jpg|thumb|Nynaeve's ki'sain]]The '''''ki'sain''''' is a small dot painted on the forehead of [[Malkier]]i women to indicate their marital status.{{ref/book|9|8}} A woman who wears the ''ki'sain'' is indicating that she has pledged her sons to fight the Shadow.{{ref/book|11|20}}

[[Nynaeve]] adopted the custom when she married [[Lan]].{{ref/book|9|8}}

== Colors ==
* Blue: unmarried, worn by [[Iselle Arrel]].{{ref/book|0|25}}
* Red: married, worn by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].{{ref/book|9|8}}
* White: widowed, worn by [[Edeyn ti Gemallen Arrel]].{{ref/book|0|22}} Note that white is generally the color of mourning in the nations of the Wheel of Time.

In death, a Malkieri woman would be marked with all three, one of each color, whether she had ever married or not.{{ref|{{twotc}}, ki'sain}} 

==Parallels==
[[File:Prajnaparamita Java.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The Goddess Tara depicted with "third eye" of consciousness represented by the bindi.]]The custom is similar to the [[wikipedia:bindi (decoration)|bindi]], meaning "point, drop, dot or small particle") is a coloured dot or, in modern times, a sticker worn on the centre of the forehead, originally by Hindus, Jains and Buddhists from the Indian subcontinent.
